subject.title: feat(model): support one-turn chat model override

question: Should one-turn model overrides ship first as inline `/model <provider/model> <message>` syntax, or should this wait for the explicit `sessions.patch` or `chat.send` API contract tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/83565?
rationale: The branch chooses an inline Gateway parsing surface, but the canonical open issue asks for an explicit public contract and the choice affects authorization, protocol compatibility, session state, response metadata, and provider/auth routing.

options.title: Define the API first
options.body: Pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and the branch is aligned to that contract.

options.title: Accept inline syntax with repairs
options.body: Allow inline `/model` as the product surface, but require authorization, auth/session isolation fixes, docs, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Reject inline syntax
options.body: Close or rework this PR so one-turn overrides only ship through a future explicit chat or session API.

recommendation.title: Define the API first
recommendation.body: Pause merge until maintainers choose the public one-turn override contract and the branch is aligned to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current history most strongly ties this Gateway/session/model-routing product boundary to `steipete`.
